thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT created for eu-west1 — multiple metrics exporters failing to reach central observability (scrape silence + 5xx). Please triage.
alex: seeing a spike of 502/timeout errors from exporters to obs-ingest in eu-west1, autoscaler alerts firing, pods stuck in Pending reprovision attempts.
maria: confirmed, cluster egress to obs-ingest IPs times out from node pools. Trying a quick fallback to local scrape before infra fix.
samir: network team reports a BGP session flap between our region peer and the observability colo at ~1863007600. They pushed a re-advertise, propagation ongoing. Could be partial segmentation.
lee: autoscaler is noisy — we should pause scale-to-zero to avoid churn while scraping is broken. Doing: 
```kubectl -n platform patch hpa/global-autoscaler --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/behavior","value":{}}]'
```
maria: rolling fallback: set METRICS_FALLBACK=local on exporters and flip CM for scrape targets. Command: 
```kubectl -n infra set env deployment/metrics-exporter METRICS_FALLBACK=local && kubectl rollout restart deployment/metrics-exporter -n infra
```
jess: pushing a quick PR to add a persistent disk-backed queue in metrics-exporter so events are buffered during upstream blackholes — https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/432 (WIP). Also adding a exporter heartbeat metric so we can detect exporter->ingest path failures faster.
alex: sample curl from node shows 502: 
```curl -v https://obs-ingest.eu-west1.internal/ingest -H 'Host: obs' --max-time 10
* Connected to obs-ingest.eu-west1.internal (10.23.45.67) port 443 (#0)
* Server returned HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* Closing connection 0
```
samir: infra note: kube-proxy logs show conntrack errors during the flap; we've increased conntrack max and reloaded iptables on affected nodes. Still watching.
maria: after the local fallback, we see metrics backfilling into regional Prometheus and Grafana panels show node/gpu capacity metrics recovering. Autoscaler alerts have quieted.
lee: paused autoscaler and removed aggressive scale policies for 30m, will revert after stability. Command used: 
```kubectl -n infra label deployment/global-autoscaler paused=true --overwrite
```
jess: Observability gap root cause: exporter lacked durable buffering and heartbeat for path health, and alerts were tuned to only central-scrape failure. Action items: add local fallback, disk queue, heartbeat metric, and alert rule for "scrape_path_down" + runbook update. Assigned to jess + maria.
alex: note — traces are missing for 12:34-12:50 in jaeger for affected services, likely because exporters dropped spans during connection errors. Need to capture for postmortem. Jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.local/trace?service=metrics-exporter
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in place — exporters switched to local scrape pool and buffering enabled. Central ingest still recovering but metrics ingestion shows steady increase.
maria: next steps: follow-up RFC for exporter resilience (disk queue + backoff + heartbeat), add synthetic 'ingest ping' monitor from each region, and improve runbook to trigger autoscaler pause. I'll open the postmortem doc.
jess: created postmortem draft and linked PR for instrumentation changes — will include instrumentation tests so future BGP/peering flaps don't erase traces/metrics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/432
samir: network will schedule a peer validation sweep for eu-west1 peering and add BGP dampening for the affected peer.
alex: thanks all — keep updates in this thread, and tag @maria when we have postmortem link. :thumbsup:
